spec.description:
The Foilboard Garage Door Kit is an all-in-one DIY thermal
insulation system engineered specifically for residential sectional and
panel-lift metal garage doors. Containing pre-cut lightweight Foilboard panels,
specialized mounting hardware, and aluminum foil tape, the kit reflects radiant
heat and stops thermal transfer into the garage. By insulating uninsulated metal
garage doors, it lowers garage temperatures by up to 10°C in summer, reduces
winter chill, and operates quietly without adding significant weight to door
spring mechanisms.
features:
Complete all-in-one DIY kit to insulate a
standard sectional garage door

Can reduce garage ambient temperature by up
to 10°C in summer

Ultra-lightweight design does not strain automatic garage
door opening mechanisms

Pre-cut panels sized to fit standard panel-lift
garage door sections

Reflects up to 97% of radiant solar heat beating on
metal door faces

Includes specialized heat-resistant adhesive pads, brackets,
and aluminum tape

Non-allergenic, non-itchy, and completely safe to handle
without PPE

Acts as an acoustic buffer, reducing external street noise and
door operating vibration

technical.value:
Fire-retardant EPS core with pure aluminum
reflective foil facings

Pre-cut panels sized to suit standard sectional door
profiles (e.g. 1350 mm x 600 mm)

total weight added to entire door

Standard single and double panel-lift / sectional

install:
Clean interior metal surfaces of garage door panels thoroughly
with isopropyl alcohol or detergent and allow to dry

Measure the width and
height of each recessed panel on the inside of the garage door

Trim Foilboard
panels to size using a utility knife and straight edge

Peel adhesive backing
and apply specialized mounting brackets to the clean metal door panels

Insert
and secure cut Foilboard panels into the mounting brackets across each door
section

Ensure panels fit neatly within door ribs without impeding hinge
knuckles or roller tracks

Tape perimeter edges with supplied reinforced
aluminum foil tape for a neat, durable finish

Test garage door operation
through full open and close cycles to ensure smooth clearance
selection_checklist:
Confirm door type is a sectional panel-lift door (not
suitable for continuous roll-up doors)

Select Single Door Kit (up to 2.4m
wide) or Double Door Kit (up to 5.5m wide)

Check door recess depth
(minimum 10-15mm recess required)

Inspect automatic opener springs (weight
addition is minimal, but check spring balance)

Ensure door panels are clean
and free of grease
limitations:
Not suitable for continuous corrugated roller doors (curtain
doors that roll into a drum)

Metal door surface must be thoroughly cleaned of
grease and dust for adhesive to bond

Ensure panels do not bind against door
tracks, cables, or side hinges during movement

problem_keywords: hot garage like an oven in summer

heat radiating from

use_cases:
Insulating metal sectional garage doors to keep attached garages up to 10°C
cooler in summer

Reducing heat transfer into living rooms or bedrooms
situated directly above or adjacent to garages

Dampening street noise and
rattle on metal panel-lift garage doors
not_for:
Continuous steel
curtain roller doors that wrap around a central drum
External weather-exposed sides of the door

The
Foilboard Garage Door Kit is an all-in-one DIY insulation system designed to
insulate residential sectional panel-lift metal garage doors. Comprising
lightweight, pre-cut Foilboard Green panels (10mm or 15mm), heavy-duty mounting
fasteners, and reinforced aluminum tape, it reflects up to 97% of radiant heat
